title: F15 — Accessibility and performance
tagline: Accessibility and performance end to end: Domain → fake data → view models → real data → tests.
intro: F15 · 14h · skeleton guide — full code is added when this feature starts.

blocks.html:
• Goal: Accessibility and performance end to end: Domain → fake data → view models → real data → tests.
  • Demo: VoiceOver walk unlock → projects → capture → report; every Instruments budget met.
  • Spec: 19 Instruments
  • Starts from: the skeleton screens (~30% of Figma) that read App/Fakes/FakeData.swift.
  • No fake repository: the fake-data step writes the real implementation on in-memory values, registered once in AppDependencies; the real-data step swaps its insides, never the type. The dev menu seeds / clears it through AppDevDataActions; test doubles live only in test targets.
  • File tags: New create the file · Edit change only the part shown.
